sites.about: STREAM Live is a live TV site made for easy watching. Open it, browse a large collection of channels with their logos, and tap any channel to start streaming. The black, minimal design keeps the focus on the video, and it looks good on phones, tablets and computers. You don't need to sign up or install anything.
sites.features:
Large collection of live TV channels in one place
Channel logos, so you can spot your favorites at a glance
Category filters to jump straight to the type of channel you want
Quick search by channel name
Nine video players to choose from, including Native, Video.js, Plyr, Shaka, Clappr, Vidstack, Media Chrome, Fluid Player and OpenPlayer
Your chosen player is remembered for your next visit
Plays different stream types, including HLS, DASH and MP4
Quality options in players that support them
Clear message with a Try again button if your connection drops
Smooth startup animation with the STREAM logo
Responsive design for mobile, tablet and desktop
Easy category browsing on desktop with arrow buttons
Click the STREAM logo any time to go back home
sites.details:
STREAM Live brings live television together in a simple, modern page. When you open the site, a short animation introduces the STREAM brand, and then you land on the full channel list. Every channel is shown as a card with its logo and name, and the list loads smoothly as you scroll, so the site stays quick even with a lot of channels.

You can narrow things down in two ways. Use the category buttons to browse by type, or type in the search box to find a channel by name. On desktop, arrow buttons let you slide through the categories easily.

Choose any channel and the player opens at the top of the page right away. You decide how you want to watch: the site includes nine popular video players, and you can switch between them from the player menu. If one player works better on your device or your connection, the site remembers your choice for next time. The player supports the common live and video stream formats, and many players also let you change the video quality.

If something goes wrong, such as a weak or lost connection, the site tells you clearly and lets you try again with one tap, instead of leaving you with a blank screen. Only the player you picked is loaded, which keeps the site light.

Whether you're on a phone, a tablet or a big screen, the layout adjusts to fit. The black theme is easy on the eyes, and the whole site is built to be simple, fast and pleasant to use.
